text: And listen to what he called her.
In that room, those words were a declaration — family of the covenant, a child of the promise.
For eighteen years she had been the bent woman, the one people stepped around.
Now, in front of everyone, he gave her back her name.
He did not say she became a daughter by being healed.
She was healed because of who she already was.
She belonged — she had always belonged.
